feed.title: JPMorgan Ex-Exec Hits Bank With Bias, Sex, Retaliation Lawsuit
feed.summary: A former JPMorgan Chase Bank & Co. vice president, Chirayu Rana, has filed a lawsuit against the bank's commercial banking arm and high-ranking finance team members. feed.title: Raymond James, Cash Sweep, Litigation
feed.summary: Raymond James Financial's legal costs have significantly increased due to cash sweep litigation, with expenses rising by $27 million, or 75% sequentially, to $63 million. CEO Paul Shoukry confirmed that the majority of this increase is tied to defending against these claims, which began in 2024 against numerous wealth management firms like JPMorgan Chase, UBS, and Morgan Stanley. These lawsuits allege that firms profited from uninvested cash in advisory accounts by paying clients low interest rates.
